title: Docker in 60 seconds

scenes.say: It works on my machine. Then it breaks on the server, because the server has different versions of everything.
Docker's fix is to ship the environment along with the app.

items.title: Image
items.say: Build it, and you get an image: your app plus everything it needs.

items.title: Container
items.say: Run the image, and you have a container.

scenes.code:
FROM node:22
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm install
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
scenes.say: Five lines. Start from Node, copy your code, install, run.
Now the same image runs on your laptop, a server, or the cloud.
Containers share the host's kernel, so they start in seconds. That's Docker. Ship the app with its world.

caption: Docker in 60 seconds: images, containers, and why the same app finally runs the same everywhere.
